system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Retrieves multi-season fertilizer usage history to identify long-term trends. For your information, my aadhaar_number is 100020008094.

function.name: pmpranam_get_usage_history
function.description: Retrieves multi-season fertilizer usage history to identify long-term trends. Requires session_token. Does NOT analyze — use pmpranam_analyze_usage_pattern. Fails if no historical records.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

num_seasons.description: Number of past seasons to retrieve. Optional, default 4.
